effects: Pulls `amount` of the collateral lskETH-OFT (0x552f…469e, set at init) from the signer to the vault with safeTransferFrom, which spends the signer's allowance to the vault.
Mints vault shares for the balance actually received and credits them to `onBehalfOf`, not to the signer, when the two differ.
Reverts if the signer is not on the depositor whitelist (which is on) or if the deposit limit is reached.
formats.shown: Deposit X lskETH-OFT into the vault, credited to the shown beneficiary.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares minted to onBehalfOf is not shown; the vault computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol deposit: `mintedShares = ERC4626Math.previewDeposit(depositedAmount, activeShares_, activeStake_); _activeSharesOf[onBehalfOf].push(...)`. The descriptor shows only amount and onBehalfOf.
findings.fix: None possible; the share rate is a storage value.

effects: Burns enough of the signer's active vault shares to cover `amount` of collateral (rounded up).

Queues `amount` lskETH-OFT for withdrawal in the next epoch and gives the claim right to `claimer`. Only `claimer` can claim it later, so the position leaves the signer when claimer is another address.
No tokens move now. The queued amount stays slashable until it can be claimed.
formats.shown: Request a withdrawal of X lskETH-OFT that the shown claim owner can claim.

findings.title: withdraw: the shares burned are not shown, and the queued amount may be slashed before it can be claimed.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol withdraw: `burnedShares = ERC4626Math.previewWithdraw(amount, activeShares(), activeStake())`. onSlash reduces `withdrawals[currentEpoch_ + 1]`. The screen shows 'Requested assets' only.
findings.fix: None needed for the shares, which come from storage. The label could say 'Requested assets (claimable next epoch, slashable)'.

effects: Burns `shares` of the signer's active vault shares.
Queues the equivalent lskETH-OFT amount (computed from storage) for withdrawal in the next epoch, claimable only by `claimer`.
No tokens move now. The queued amount stays slashable until it can be claimed.
formats.shown: Queue N raw vault shares for withdrawal, with the claim right going to the shown claim owner.

findings.title: redeem: shares are shown as a raw 18-decimal integer in both the intent and the field.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem field `#.shares` format 'raw'. Case 2 shows '987654321123456789'. ERC4626Math._decimalsOffset() returns 0, so shares use the collateral's 18 decimals.
findings.fix: Use format 'unit' with params {decimals: 18, base: 'shares'} (or a label naming the vault shares) so the value reads as about 0.9877 shares.

findings.title: redeem: the lskETH-OFT amount queued for withdrawal is not shown; it is computed from storage.

effects: Marks the signer's withdrawal for `epoch` as claimed.
Sends the signer's full withdrawal for that epoch (withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender), from storage) in lskETH-OFT to `recipient`.
formats.shown: Claim the withdrawal for epoch N to the shown recipient.

findings.title: claim: the asset paid out (lskETH-OFT) is not named in the intent or any field.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claim: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount)`. The descriptor intent is 'Claim withdrawal' and the fields are Vault, Epoch and Recipient.
findings.fix: Name the asset in the intent, e.g. 'Claim lskETH-OFT withdrawal' and 'Claim lskETH-OFT from epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'.

findings.title: claim: the amount sent to the recipient comes from storage and is not shown.

effects: Marks the signer's withdrawal for each listed epoch as claimed.
Sends the sum of the signer's withdrawals for those epochs (from storage) in lskETH-OFT to `recipient` in a single transfer.
formats.shown: Claim the withdrawals for the listed epochs to the shown recipient.

findings.title: claimBatch: the asset paid out (lskETH-OFT) is not named in the intent or any field.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount)`. The descriptor intent is 'Claim withdrawals' and the fields are Vault, Epoch[] and Recipient.
findings.fix: Name the asset in the intent, e.g. 'Claim lskETH-OFT withdrawals'.

findings.title: claimBatch: the total amount sent to the recipient comes from storage and is not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: `amount += _claim(epochs[i])`, where _claim reads withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender).
